articles.original_title: Irreducible Governance Structure for Autonomous Agent Systems: Fair Allocation, Strategy-Proofness, and Multi-Scale Composition
articles.title_pt: Estrutura de Governança Irredutível para Sistemas de Agentes Autônomos: Alocação Justa, Resistência a Estratégias e Composição em Múltiplas Escalas
articles.excerpt: Autonomous agent governance is commonly framed as a problem of enforcing correct execution. However, in multi-agent systems, an equally fundamental question precedes execution: which agents are allowed to act. In this paper, we show that allocation is not an auxiliary concern but a structural component of governance. When multiple agents compete for execution under constrained resources, any allocation mechanism introduces unavoidable trade-offs between fairness, efficiency, and resistance to strategic manipulation. We formalize this through a…
articles.summary: Estudo analisa como a alocação de recursos em sistemas multi-agentes é um componente estrutural de governança. O artigo formaliza os trade-offs entre justiça, eficiência e resistência a manipulações estratégicas.

articles.original_title: MOZAIC: An Audio-Video Deepfake Benchmark for Telling What Is Fake
articles.title_pt: MOZAIC: Um Benchmark de Deepfake de Áudio e Vídeo para Identificar o que é Falso
articles.excerpt: Audio-video (AV) deepfakes can fake the face, the voice, or both. Most benchmarks only ask whether a clip is real or fake, so they cannot show whether a detector relies on the picture, the voice, or encoding traces. We present MOZAIC, a paired benchmark with a 4-way label in which every source clip is released in all four combinations of real or fake video and real or fake audio so each modality contribution can be measured directly. Fakes cover inner-face swapping, whole-frame video diffusion and voice conversion. MOZAIC has 137,745 clips from…
articles.summary: Pesquisadores apresentam o MOZAIC, um benchmark pareado com 137.745 clipes para avaliar a contribuição individual de áudio e vídeo na detecção de deepfakes. A ferramenta aborda trocas faciais, difusão de vídeo e conversão de voz.

articles.original_title: Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Sets for Incomplete Data
articles.title_pt: Conjuntos Nebulosos de Sobreposição Conservadora para Dados Incompletos
articles.excerpt: Attribute reduction in incomplete information systems is difficult because missing values break the equivalence-class structure of rough set theory. We propose the Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Set (COFRS) model. Each object is described by its set of present attributes. The similarity of two objects is a weighted overlap on the attributes present in both, divided by the fixed number of attributes |A| instead of the size of their union, so missing values are penalised globally and are not matched as wildcards. From this similarity we define a…
articles.summary: O artigo propõe o modelo Conservative Overlap Fuzzy Rough Set para lidar com a redução de atributos em sistemas de informação incompletos. A abordagem penaliza valores ausentes globalmente por meio de uma similaridade ponderada.

articles.excerpt: TabPFN has already shown useful predictive performance on near-infrared spectra. RamanPFN subsequently proposed two spectral representations for tabular inference: Global Compositional Unmixing (GCU) and Local Vibrational Subspace Encoding (LVSE). We assess whether these representations also help on datasets assembled through the nirs4all ecosystem, and whether their value extends to classical calibration. We reanalyse completed experiments from a public spectral dataset catalogue. On a post-hoc subset of 61 matched numerical prediction tasks…
articles.summary: O trabalho avalia representações espectrais como Global Compositional Unmixing e Local Vibrational Subspace Encoding em tarefas de predição numérica. A análise utiliza conjuntos de dados públicos para testar o desempenho em espectros de infravermelho próximo.

articles.original_title: Actionwave: A Systematic Benchmark for Waveform-Centric Clinical Prediction Across Care Scenarios

articles.excerpt: Continuous bedside waveforms record rapid physiological changes that can inform clinical decisions. Existing benchmarks examine selected prediction conditions, but it remains unclear how model advantages depend on signal duration, warning time, and available inputs across care settings. We introduce Actionwave, a benchmark for waveform-centric clinical prediction across intensive-care, operating-room, and emergency-department settings. Actionwave uses a common decision-time prediction interface and groups clinically grounded tasks by what is…
articles.summary: A pesquisa introduz o Actionwave, um benchmark voltado para predições clínicas baseadas em formas de onda fisiológicas contínuas. O sistema unifica tarefas em UTIs, salas de cirurgia e departamentos de emergência.

articles.original_title: Chain-of-Thought Is Not Explainability
articles.title_pt: Cadeia de Pensamento Não É Explicabilidade
articles.excerpt: Chain-of-thought (CoT) allows language models to verbalise multi-step rationales before producing their final answer. While this technique often boosts task performance and offers an impression of transparency into the model's reasoning, this position paper argues that rationales generated by current CoT techniques can be misleading and are neither necessary nor sufficient for trustworthy interpretability. We analyse faithfulness as whether CoTs are not only human-interpretable but also reflect the model's underlying reasoning well enough to…
articles.summary: Este artigo argumenta que raciocínios gerados por modelos de linguagem através de cadeia de pensamento podem ser enganosos. Os autores analisam que tais justificativas não são suficientes para garantir uma interpretabilidade verdadeiramente confiável.

articles.original_title: Learning from Human Corrections through Temporal Preferences

articles.excerpt: When people intervene to correct a robot, they provide information not only through how they correct its behavior, but also through when they choose to intervene. Existing approaches to Learning from Corrections focus on comparing the new trajectory to the robot's originally intended behavior, thus underutilizing the context of the robot's behavior before the intervention. In this work, we investigate how both pre- and post-intervention behavior can be translated into preference pairs for learning value functions that approximate a human's…
articles.summary: O estudo investiga como intervenções humanas para corrigir robôs podem ser aproveitadas por meio de pares de preferência. A abordagem utiliza tanto o comportamento anterior quanto o posterior à intervenção para aprimorar funções de valor.

articles.original_title: Beyond Static Charts: Benchmarking Interactive Chart-to-Code Generation for MLLMs
articles.title_pt: Além de Gráficos Estáticos: Avaliação Comparativa de Geração de Código de Gráficos Interativos para MLLMs
articles.excerpt: In recent years, multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved significant progress in chart-to-code generation. However, existing benchmarks mainly focus on static charts, overlooking interactive charts that enable richer and more expressive data exploration. Unlike static chart-to-code generation, which emphasizes visual consistency, interactive chart-to-code evaluation targets behavioral consistency, requiring chart states to evolve correctly under sequences of user interactions, thereby rendering traditional one-step evaluation…
articles.summary: Modelos multimodais de linguagem avançaram na geração de códigos para gráficos, mas focavam em modelos estáticos. Novos estudos propõem avaliar a consistência comportamental em gráficos interativos submetidos a interações.

articles.original_title: What People Choose Not to Say: A Multimodal Benchmark for Fine-Grained Information Manipulation in Conversations
articles.title_pt: O que as pessoas escolhem não dizer: um benchmark multimodal para manipulação de informações sutis em conversas
articles.excerpt: Recent advances in MLLMs have improved social understanding, enabling models to recognize emotions and distinguish truthful from deceptive behaviors. However, existing benchmarks largely focus on coarse-grained emotion recognition or binary truth-deception detection, overlooking the diverse ways people manipulate information in conversations, such as withholding, leakage, fabrication, evasion, and defensive counterclaim. Understanding these behaviors requires reasoning about underlying facts, participant knowledge, and conversational context…
articles.summary: Avanços em modelos multimodais melhoraram o reconhecimento de emoções e mentiras, mas ignoravam táticas conversacionais complexas como omissão, evasão e fabricação, exigindo raciocínio sobre o contexto factual.

articles.original_title: Antares-Smaug: Adversarial Names, Tokens and Attack Rewrites: Sanitisers Miss Unseen Generalisations
articles.title_pt: Antares-Smaug: Nomes Adversariais, Tokens e Ataques Reescritos: Sanitizadores Falham em Generalizações Ocultas
articles.excerpt: Laya is an open decision model: given a text, a question and K named options with descriptions, it returns one probability per option in a single pass, and software may act on the answer unseen. We attack six Laya models with 81 programmatic edits of 566 synthetic items (injected sentences, label leaks, edited descriptions, decoy options, invisible and look-alike characters, floods) and report the share of correctly answered items hijacked or lost, with bootstrap intervals. Attack wordings that no defence was built from win the attacker's option…
articles.summary: Pesquisadores testaram modelos de decisão abertos como Laya contra edições programáticas e ataques textuais variados. O estudo relata a taxa de itens comprometidos e a eficácia de estratégias que driblam defesas.

articles.original_title: Hidden Clues in WM-811K: Uncovering the Spatial Signals Behind Wafer Map Prediction
articles.title_pt: Pistas Ocultas no WM-811K: Descobrindo os Sinais Espaciais por Trás da Predição de Mapas de Wafer
articles.excerpt: WM-811K (also known as LSWMD) is a wafer map dataset first made publicly available in a 2015 paper by Wu et al. Convolutional neural networks have been used to achieve high classification accuracy on this dataset, yet it's not easy to decipher which features of the dataset are driving that performance. This study attempts to answer this specifically for WM-811K: how much of the predictive performance results from the wafer layout, the count of failed dies, their distance from the center and their exact 2-D location. After analyzing duplicate…
articles.summary: O estudo analisa o conjunto de dados WM-811K para entender quais fatores impulsionam a alta precisão de redes neurais na classificação. A pesquisa investiga o impacto do layout e da localização de falhas.

articles.original_title: Conformalized Tree-Based Gradient Ensembles for Out-of-Distribution Detection and Plausible Recourse
articles.title_pt: Ensembles de Gradiente Baseados em Árvores Conformalizados para Detecção Fora de Distribuição e Recurso Plausível
articles.excerpt: Counterfactual recourse provides actionable feature adjustments that reverse unfavourable predictions made by automated decision models. However, when recourse search optimizes purely against classifier confidence or narrow proxy scores over gradient-boosted decision trees (GBDT), search procedures can exploit boundary artifacts and low-density regions---an instance of Goodhart's law---yielding out-of-distribution (OOD) recommendations that appear favourable nominally while lacking manifold plausibility. In this paper, we study conformalized OOD…
articles.summary: O artigo aborda como buscas por recurso contrafactual em árvores de decisão impulsionadas por gradiente podem explorar artefatos de fronteira. O estudo propõe métodos para evitar recomendações fora de distribuição.

articles.original_title: Layer-Readout Interfaces in EEG Foundation Models: Predictive Accessibility and Cross-Dataset Transfer
articles.title_pt: Interfaces de Leitura de Camadas em Modelos de Fundação EEG: Acessibilidade Preditiva e Transferência Entre Conjuntos de Dados
articles.excerpt: Intermediate layers often outperform final layers when foundation models are used as frozen feature extractors, but the source of this advantage is unclear. We study this question in EEG foundation models by separating three factors: how representations are read out, whether intermediate layers provide predictive utility beyond the final-layer interface, and whether useful depth structure transfers across datasets. Across five models and three tasks, improving the final-layer readout consistently recovers substantial predictive performance, yet…
articles.summary: Estudou-se por que camadas intermediárias de modelos de fundação superam as finais ao atuar como extratores de feições. A pesquisa avalia a utilidade preditiva e a transferência de estruturas entre diferentes tarefas.

articles.original_title: Geometric Control Analysis of an Internally Actuated Flying Wing
articles.title_pt: Análise de Controle Geométrico de uma Asa Voadora Internamente Atuada
articles.excerpt: This paper presents a rigorous geometric accessibility and controllability analysis for a fixed-wing Uncrewed Aircraft System (UAS) actuated solely by an internal moving mass, a momentum wheel, and external thrust. This configuration eliminates traditional control surfaces, which in turn reduces the combinatorial set of computational fluid dynamics (CFD) studies necessary for high-fidelity modeling of flight through unsteady flow fields. Using Lie bracket computations and the strong Lie Algebra Rank Condition, it is shown that the full nonlinear…
articles.summary: O artigo apresenta uma rigorosa análise de acessibilidade e controlabilidade geométrica para uma aeronave não tripulada de asa fixa acionada por massa móvel interna, roda de momento e empuxo externo.

articles.original_title: CRAB-H: Task-Centric Certification for Healthcare Autonomous Systems
articles.title_pt: CRAB-H: Certificação Centrada em Tarefas para Sistemas Autônomos de Saúde
articles.excerpt: This paper introduces CRAB H as a task-centric certification methodology for healthcare autonomous systems. CRAB H extends the ARC governance architecture by introducing the task as a first-class governance object, represented through Task Requirement Profiles TRP H. Each profile defines the cognitive capabilities, governance constraints, evidentiary requirements, and operational assumptions necessary for the safe execution of a specific healthcare activity. Rather than asking whether a robot achieves a sufficiently high benchmark score, CRAB H…
articles.summary: O trabalho introduz o CRAB H como metodologia de certificação centrada em tarefas para sistemas autônomos de saúde, estendendo a arquitetura de governança ARC com perfis de requisitos de tarefas.

articles.original_title: ContextLure: Exploiting Benign Conversation History for Indirect Prompt Injection
articles.title_pt: ContextLure: Explorando o Histórico de Conversas Benignas para Injeção Indireta de Prompt
articles.excerpt: As LLMs become more capable, agents can perform more complex tasks with tools and maintain longer interactions with users. These benign conversations contain evidence on task results, user concerns, and operational constraints. The risk is that attackers who can observe benign conversations (evidence) may construct stronger indirect prompt injections without increasing the attackers' control over prior turns or the later injection. However, we still lack a clear study of how effectively attackers can select and use this evidence. To address this…
articles.summary: Pesquisadores analisam como atacantes podem observar conversas benignas em modelos de linguagem para construir injeções indiretas de prompt mais fortes. O estudo examina os riscos associados ao uso de ferramentas e interações prolongadas com usuários.

articles.original_title: Learning What vs. Learning How: Decomposing Task and Interface Competence in Agentic Training
articles.title_pt: Aprendendo O Quê versus Aprendendo Como: Decompondo a Competência de Tarefa e Interface no Treinamento de Agentes
articles.excerpt: LLM agents operate through harnesses that define system prompts, action formats, feedback loops, and resource constraints. A model may possess the knowledge needed to solve a task yet fail to express that knowledge through a particular harness. This raises a basic question: when a policy fails under a given harness, is it missing task knowledge or the competence to operate the interface? We distinguish two components of agentic competence: task competence, the knowledge and reasoning needed to solve a task, and interface competence, the ability…
articles.summary: O artigo investiga falhas em políticas de agentes baseados em modelos de linguagem, diferenciando a falta de conhecimento da tarefa da falta de competência para operar a interface. O estudo aborda os componentes essenciais da competência em agentes.

articles.original_title: Taxi: Analyzing Agents at (Real) Scale
articles.title_pt: Taxi: Analisando Agentes em Escala (Real)
articles.excerpt: In this technical report, we present Taxi -- a system for debugging, clustering, and monitoring agents at scale. Taxi scales to millions of steps efficiently. This is made possible by a combination of scalable analysis methods. Taxi relies primarily on clustering to generate a taxonomy over steps for a structured overview of the data, and provides full SQL access for engineers and automated agents to ask complex questions. Clustering and querying are best used together in a hybrid pipeline guided by a coding agent. Taxi also includes an…
articles.summary: O relatório técnico apresenta o Taxi, um sistema eficiente projetado para depurar, agrupar e monitorar agentes em larga escala. A ferramenta combina métodos de análise escaláveis e acesso SQL para engenheiros e agentes automatizados.

articles.original_title: Flagging Batch Shift in Flow Cytometry using Jeffreys Divergence between Gaussian Mixtures
articles.title_pt: Sinalizando Desvio de Lote em Citometria de Fluxo Usando a Divergência de Jeffreys entre Misturas Gaussianas
articles.excerpt: Machine learning models for clinical flow cytometry are usually evaluated on data drawn from their training distribution. In routine practice, however, acquisition conditions and reagents may change, potentially making predictions unreliable without warning. We propose a model agnostic criterion for prediction reliability based on a notion of distance from the training distribution: each patient sample is represented by a Gaussian mixture model, and its Jeffreys divergence to a reference fitted on the training data is estimated using Monte Carlo…
articles.summary: O estudo pro-põe um critério agnóstico de modelo para avaliar a confiabilidade de previsões em citometria de fluxo clínica. A técnica mede a distância da distribuição de treinamento usando modelos de mistura gaussiana.

articles.original_title: Fusion Gains Depend on the Implementation and the Calibration Target: An 18-Task Study of Prediction Intervals with a Single-Source Fallback
articles.title_pt: Os Ganhos de Fusão Dependem da Implementação e do Alvo de Calibração: Um Estudo de 18 Tarefas de Intervalos de Previsão com Fallback de Fonte Ùnica
articles.excerpt: A fused model can benefit from an extra learning stage as well as from a second data source. We compare four fusion implementations with matched single-source learners on 18 regression tasks with prediction intervals. Across ten refits under group-wise calibration, linear stacking improved the interval score by 6.0% against a source model without a second stage and by 0.1% against its matched single source. The four implementations agreed on 3 of 18 tasks and gave opposite clear verdicts on 12, including 8 of the 10 tasks with naturally distinct…
articles.summary: A pesquisa compara diferentes implementações de fusão com modelos de fonte única em tarefas de regressão. Os resultados demonstram como diferentes abordagens afetam o desempenho dos intervalos de previsão sob calibração.

articles.original_title: GHC:Expanding Residual Interfaces in Hyper-Connections
articles.title_pt: GHC: Expandindo Interfaces Residuais em Hiper-Conexões
articles.excerpt: Hyper-Connections expand residual capacity across parallel streams, yet restrict every branch to narrow read and write interfaces: each branch still reads a single stream mixture and writes scaled copies of one output vector to all streams. To lift this bottleneck, we propose Grouped Hyper-Connections (GHC). By partitioning each branch into parallel groups along attention heads or FFN channels, GHC supplies each group with a distinct stream mixture and aggregates their separate outputs into each stream with learned weights. Extensive experiments…
articles.summary: O artigo propõe as Hiper-Conexões Agrupadas para superar gargalos de capacidade residual em fluxos paralelos. A nova abordagem divide ramos em grupos para fornecer misturas de fluxo distintas e melhorar o aprendizado.

articles.original_title: Embodied Neuro-symbolic AI: Making Robot Behavior Auditable, Safe, and Scalable
articles.title_pt: IA Neuro-simbólica Embutida: Tornando o Comportamento de Robôs Auditáveis, Seguros e Escaláveis
articles.excerpt: Current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) end-to-end systems have driven major progress in robot learning, yet they still face persistent barriers to dependable real-world deployment. In practice, these models often exhibit brittle generalization under distribution shift (i.e., novel objects, layouts, lighting, or contact conditions), limited physical and causal reasoning, and inconsistent fine-grained motor control. Critically, many VLA pipelines offer limited ways to express and audit what a robot must not do, making it difficult to provide…
articles.summary: Sistemas de visão-linguagem-ação enfrentam barreiras na implantação prática devido à generalização frágil e raciocínio limitado. O texto discute caminhos para tornar o comportamento de robôs mais seguro e auditável.

articles.original_title: Hi3R-VLA: Grounding Semantics and Actions in 3D
articles.title_pt: Hi3R-VLA: Fundamentando Semântica e Ações em 3D
articles.excerpt: While recent vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly incorporate 3D geometry, how to effectively exploit it for precise and generalizable action prediction remains a central challenge. We introduce Hi3R-VLA, a 3D policy that grounds heterogeneous modalities - vision, language, and action - in explicit 3D geometry for robotic manipulation. Our model integrates spatially-aligned visual features and language conditioning into point cloud representations, enriching scene geometry with fine-grained, task-relevant semantics. It then anchors…
articles.summary: O artigo introduçe o Hi3R-VLA, uma política tridimensional voltada para manipulação robótica que integra geometria espacial, visão e linguagem. O modelo enriquece representações de nuvem de pontos com semântica detalhada para previsão de ações.

articles.original_title: SpatialCraft: Evolving Procedural Intelligence from Experience and Skills for Spatial Reasoning Agents
articles.title_pt: SpatialCraft: Evoluindo Inteligência Procedural a partir de Experiência e Habilidades para Agentes de Raciocínio Espacial
articles.excerpt: Spatial reasoning agents increasingly rely on external tools, such as 3D reconstruction, segmentation, and geometric computation, to answer questions that a multimodal large language model (MLLM) cannot resolve from pixels alone. Tool access, however, shifts the bottleneck to orchestration: the agent must decide which tools to call, in what order, and how to interpret their outputs, yet a stateless agent repeats the same mistakes across tasks. We ask whether a frozen tool-using agent can improve its orchestration from its own interaction…
articles.summary: O estudo explora como agentes de raciocínio espacial, que utilizam ferramentas externas, podem melhorar sua orquestração de tarefas. A pesquisa questiona se um agente pode aprender a corrigir erros de interação e otimizar o uso de ferramentas de forma autônoma.

articles.original_title: Evaluating Frontier-Model Agent Skills with Open-Weight Models in a Science Gateway
articles.title_pt: Avaliando Habilidades de Agentes de Modelos de Fronteira com Modelos de Pesos Abertos em um Portal Científico
articles.excerpt: Scientific analyses that span many jobs and computing sites depend on workflow management systems to run reliably, but writing a production workflow requires expertise in such a system, which many domain scientists do not have. Coding agents can supply this expertise when they are guided by skills and packaged procedures for recurring tasks. We wrote skills and specialist agents for the Pegasus workflow management system with a frontier model, and the PegasusAI Studio science gateway offers them to scientists through a chat interface. New users…
articles.summary: O PegasusAI Studio utiliza agentes de codificação para auxiliar cientistas na gestão de fluxos de trabalho complexos. A ferramenta permite que usuários sem experiência técnica executem tarefas computacionais por meio de uma interface de chat.

articles.original_title: XRL4T1D: A Post-hoc Explainability Framework for Reinforcement Learning in Type 1 Diabetes Management
articles.title_pt: XRL4T1D: Uma Estrutura de Explicabilidade Post-hoc para Aprendizado por Reforço no Gerenciamento de Diabetes Tipo 1
articles.excerpt: Type 1 diabetes (T1D) requires lifelong insulin therapy, and reinforcement learning (RL) has shown promise for automated dosing in the UVA/Padova simulator. However, the decisions of RL controllers remain difficult to interpret. We present XRL4T1D, a post-hoc explainability framework for evaluating pretrained insulin-dosing policies without retraining. Each policy uses 60 minutes of continuous glucose monitor (CGM) and administered-insulin history, sampled every 5 minutes, to recommend insulin. We use SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to…
articles.summary: O XRL4T1D é um framework de explicabilidade desenvolvido para interpretar decisões de dosagem de insulina feitas por sistemas de aprendizado por reforço. A ferramenta utiliza dados de monitores contínuos de glicose para avaliar políticas de tratamento sem necessidade de retreinamento.

articles.original_title: Detecting Harmful Short Videos in Toxic Diet Culture: A Governance-Ready Evidence Framework with Sparse Autoencoders
articles.title_pt: Detectando Vídeos Curtos Prejudiciais na Cultura de Dieta Tóxica: Uma Estrutura de Evidências Pronta para Governança com Autoencoders Esparsos
articles.excerpt: Algorithmic content moderation is increasingly important for governing short-form video content, yet harmful-content detection research focuses primarily on prediction or limited explanations. This leaves a governance challenge underexplored: producing decision-linked evidence that supports the review and justification of moderation decisions. Using toxic diet culture as an empirical case, we conceptualize governance-ready evidence as computational traceability, evidence localization, policy grounding, and evidence inspectability. We develop the…
articles.summary: A pesquisa propõe um sistema para moderar conteúdos prejudiciais em vídeos curtos, focando na cultura de dieta tóxica. O modelo busca fornecer evidências rastreáveis e justificáveis para apoiar decisões de moderação algorítmica.

articles.original_title: CaLA: Causal Latent Adjustment for World Models under Adaptive Policies
articles.title_pt: CaLA: Ajuste Latente Causal para Modelos de Mundo sob Políticas Adaptativas
articles.excerpt: World models is answering ``imagine" answers to ``what-if'' questions via imagined rollouts. But rollouts collected by adaptive policies induce treatment-outcome confounding in imagined rollouts. We study this problem in Match-3 difficulty adjustment, where latent player skill influences both assigned difficulty and churn. We build a fully specified Match-3 SCM with sequential mechanics, adaptive assignment, and paired ground-truth interventions, on which unadjusted models fit to the logged trajectories select difficulty settings that raise…
articles.summary: O estudo aborda o problema de confusão entre tratamento e resultado em modelos de mundo, onde políticas adaptativas distorcem simulações. Os pesquisadores criaram um modelo específico para jogos Match-3 para ajustar a dificuldade e evitar que modelos não ajustados aumentem a rotatividade de jogadores.

articles.original_title: Is 4 Bits Enough for EEG Sleep Staging? A Subject-Level Benchmark of MXFP4, NVFP4 and FP8
articles.title_pt: 4 bits são suficientes para o estagiamento do sono via EEG? Um benchmark de nível de sujeito de MXFP4, NVFP4 e FP8
articles.excerpt: Staging sleep on a wearable device keeps the raw electroencephalogram (EEG) private and saves the energy needed to transmit it. It also requires small, energy-efficient neural networks. We benchmark 13 post-training quantization (PTQ) configurations, from FP16 to the block-scaled 4-bit formats MXFP4 and NVFP4, for five-stage sleep staging from single-channel Fpz-Cz EEG. We use Sleep-EDF-78 (78 subjects), subject-wise cross-validation, three training seeds, value-exact emulation, and per-subject paired statistics. All 8- and 16-bit formats stay…
articles.summary: Pesquisadores avaliaram 13 configurações de quantização para monitoramento de sono em dispositivos vestíveis usando EEG. O objetivo é reduzir o consumo de energia e manter a privacidade dos dados, testando formatos de 4 bits como alternativas eficientes aos modelos de 8 e 16 bits.

articles.original_title: Sampling at Scale: Distributed Multi-Agent Trajectory Optimization
articles.title_pt: Amostragem em Escala: Otimização Distribuída de Trajetória Multiagente
articles.excerpt: Multi-agent trajectory optimization poses two coupled challenges: effectively exploring non-convex landscapes and scaling favorably to large teams of agents. Sampling-based methods are natural candidates for the exploration challenge but scale poorly with problem dimension. Moreover, their off-the-shelf integration into distributed optimization introduces a fundamental trade-off: sampling either fails to address the constraint-induced non-convexity or its search space grows with neighborhood size. We address this gap by introducing a…
articles.summary: O trabalho propõe uma solução para os desafios de otimização de trajetória em sistemas multiagente. O foco é superar as dificuldades de exploração em cenários não convexos e garantir que os métodos baseados em amostragem escalem adequadamente para grandes equipes de agentes.

articles.original_title: FabricBench: A Standardized Policy Benchmark for Bimanual Fabric Manipulation with a Contact-Driven Deformable Simulator
articles.title_pt: FabricBench: Um benchmark padronizado para manipulação bimanual de tecidos com simulador de contato
articles.excerpt: Fabric manipulation challenges robot policies with changing geometry, self-occlusion, and contact, yet standardized evaluation remains focused on rigid objects. We introduce FabricBench, a benchmark for bimanual fabric manipulation with six tasks spanning garments, silk, and bags, 10,000 simulation-ready assets, and controlled tests of configuration and appearance generalization. Built on an open-source solver in Newton, our simulator enables stable bimanual grasping, holding, and release through contact forces, without artificial attachment…
articles.summary: O FabricBench é um novo benchmark para avaliar robôs na manipulação de tecidos, como roupas e bolsas. Utilizando um simulador baseado em Newton, o sistema permite testes de generalização e manipulação bimanual estável através de forças de contato.

articles.original_title: PatientFlowSynth: Evaluating FHIR Agents with Matched Patient Charts
articles.title_pt: PatientFlowSynth: avaliação de agentes FHIR com prontuários de pacientes correspondentes

In Fast Healthcare Interoperability Resources (FHIR), status fields can change how those records should be interpreted. PatientFlowSynth provides 18,000 tasks from 225 synthetic patients and 18 templates that hold the patient, question, and retrieval program fixed across chart variants representing four evidence states. Re-executing the program verifies each variant's reference answer, evidence sets, and search…

articles.original_title: One Step, Four Clocks: How GUI Agents Fall Out of Step
articles.title_pt: Uma etapa, quatro relógios: como os agentes de interface gráfica do usuário perdem o sincronismo

articles.original_title: Agent Evaluation Without Ground Truth: A Null Proportion Perspective
articles.title_pt: Avaliação de agentes sem ground truth: uma perspectiva de proporção nula
articles.excerpt: The correctness of actions taken by agents is typically evaluated against known, externally verified ground truth labels, such as whether a proof is correct or whether code compiles and passes unit tests. articles.original_title: Transformers with Signatures: Towards Universal In-Context Learning in Path Space
articles.title_pt: Transformers com assinaturas: rumo ao aprendizado universal no contexto no espaço de caminhos

articles.original_title: Small Learned Projections for Semantic-Reversal-Aware Retrieval with Spectral Acceleration: A Four-Domain Empirical Study
articles.title_pt: Pequenas projeções aprendidas para recuperação com reconhecimento de reversão semântica e aceleração espectral: um estudo empírico de quatro domínios

articles.original_title: Transferable, Time-Parallel Graph Dynamics via Space-Time Factorization
articles.title_pt: Dinâmica de grafos transferível e paralela no tempo por meio da fatoração espaço-tempo

articles.original_title: A Self-Organizing Swarm Control Model for Underwater Robots Based on Turing-Type Reaction-Diffusion Principles
articles.title_pt: Um modelo de controle de enxame auto-organizado para robôs subaquáticos baseado nos princípios de reação-difusão do tipo Turing
articles.excerpt: In underwater environments, Global Positioning System (GPS) signals and high-speed radio communication are unavailable, and severe constraints exist on communication bandwidth and visibility; consequently, applying conventional swarm formation methods, such as the Boids model, which require the relative positions and velocity vectors of neighboring vehicles, is difficult. This study proposes a decentralized swarm control model that operates without a leader or absolute coordinates, relying solely on the number of received signals from two…
articles.summary: O estudo propõe um modelo de controle de enxame descentralizado para ambientes subaquáticos onde o GPS e o rádio falham. A técnica opera sem líder ou coordenadas absolutas, utilizando apenas sinais recebidos.

articles.original_title: Collision Rendering: GPU-Accelerated Trajectory Planning on Sparse Voxel Radiance Fields with Risk-Bounded Collision Checking
articles.title_pt: Renderização de colisões: planejamento de trajetórias acelerado por GPU em campos de radiância de voxels esparsos com verificação de colisões com limite de risco
articles.excerpt: Although radiance fields provide detailed scene representations for robotics, they remain underexplored for trajectory planning, without a widely agreed-upon way to translate learned spatial primitives into reliable collision criteria. To bridge this gap, we introduce Collision Rendering, the first trajectory planning framework on sparse voxel radiance fields (SVR), which supports GPU-accelerated, risk-bounded collision checking and a differentiable collision cost. articles.summary: A pesquisa apresenta o Collision Rendering, um framework de planejamento de trajetória em campos de radiância voxel esparsa. A tecnologia suporta verificação de colisão acelerada por GPU e custo diferenciável.

articles.original_title: Agent Recovery Gone Wrong: Measuring Harm Beyond Duplicate Calls
articles.title_pt: Recuperação de Agentes que Deu Errado: Medindo Danos Além de Chamadas Duplicadas
articles.excerpt: Code-executing LLM agents submit blocks of code that issue several API writes. It is unknown how often such a recovery harms the external state when the failure occurs naturally in the code written by the agent. In this paper, we measure it on recorded trajectories of AppWorld agents. Se um bloco falhar após algumas de suas gravações terem entrado em vigor, o agente reescreve o bloco e continua.
